result.reason: The redline adds Affiliates, contractors, termination only for uncured material breach, and M&A-successor transferability, but it does not make any paid-up licence perpetual and irrevocable. It also leaves clause (c)'s absolute prohibitions on assignment, transfer, sublicensing and outsourcing unchanged, creating conflicts with the successor-transfer and contractor rights. Clause (e) is imprecise because it treats Affiliates, which are entities, as 'individuals.' The changes are otherwise targeted and retain the Field of Use and unrelated restrictions.
